grading_prompt: Independently audit each anonymous report against the supplied point-in-time evidence and frozen case standard. Check all submitted linkages in listed order. Report one CandidateGrade per displayed linkage, with 1-based index. For evidence check both endpoints and whether the factual premise is actually supported, not just cited. For mechanism check a precise directional operating step and a necessary observable condition. For financial_effect check the direction and metric at the correct business, calibrated to the available amounts. For falsifier check a named public source and same-period observable result that discriminates the mechanism from at least one plausible alternate explanation. A milestone may verify the mechanism without certifying financial materiality if the limitations are clear. A missing disclosure is not a falsifier. target_path means the link genuinely addresses the specified standard or an equally supported equivalent. major_error is reserved for an affirmative unsupported claim of resource transfer, cross-company order or customer diversion, an assertion that concurrent guidance proves causation, or material false facts, money or attribution. Mark every such error even if another linkage passes. A hypothesis explicitly conditional on unconfirmed evidence is not an affirmative claim. Evaluate the entire submission for major_error, including the gap. On a negative case set gap_ok only if the gap or a path names missing evidence specific to the trap and explicitly withholds its attribution. A separate evidenced transmission is compatible with that judgment. On a positive case gap_ok is informational only. Score evidence and logic, not style, size, labels or known later results. Return concise Traditional Chinese notes and one verdict per anonymous label.

rubric.rule_check: 每條另核對非空、可見的起點與受影響引文及期限。Harness 使用產品實際發布的欄位，另保留被過濾的候選。
rubric.positive: 至少一條同時通過程式核對、對應預註冊路徑及模型四項語義判讀，且全稿零重大錯誤。
rubric.negative: 指出預註冊陷阱缺少的證據、保留歸因、稿中各條引文均有效，且零重大錯誤。
rubric.truth: 先導與保留集先以已封存裁定加匿名 Sol 單次判讀作流程門檻。人工獨立覆核另計。每案的呈現順序交替。

stop: 先導配對與評分通過後才啟動保留集。已開始的失敗呼叫占用額度且不重試。容量或用量錯誤只對尚未開始的工作依公告冷卻，最多 900 秒，缺提示採 30 秒。等待超限即停止該批。未取得完整配對不做模型比較評分。一般中斷只接續未開始的工作。
regression: Ford 和 ASML 使用已保留的 V10 原始有效連動離線驗證，排除計分。
